comment: Every story flag id of the game, with one line of prose for each (D-542, D-1003). A flag is a name that is on or off, and a load fails on a flag id that this file does not declare. A condition, a set flag step, and a choose step each name a flag of this file. PR-68 built the flags with no flag of its own. PR-12 adds the fixture flag of the side aptitude of Marrek, and the arc content of PR-17 and later PRs adds each flag of the story here.

flags.note: The fixture flag that unlocks the side aptitude of Marrek, which the tests of PR-12 set (D-538, D-556).
